```lean
import PrisonersDilemma.Program

open PD
namespace PD.Bots

/-- MyBot: cooperate when the opponent is provably cooperative against me and provably not an unconditional cooperator. -/
def MyBot (k : Nat) : Prog :=
  .search k
    (.plays .opp .self .C)
    (.search k
      (.plays .opp (.const .D) .D)
      (.const .C)
      (.const .D))
    (.const .D)

end PD.Bots
```
